messages.text: Reliability operations needs one defensible decision for meter-based lubrication program by 2026-01-16; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside effective meter threshold and blackout calendar determine the due date.
I found 2150 HOURS on the header, but the workbook has separate observation and exclusion rows. Please do not net from this message.

Approval AP-0026 permits one control-compliant action on NS-000026 up to 2000 HOURS, provided effective meter threshold and blackout calendar determine the due date. It does not select an option in advance and does not authorize broader records or generate_emergency_work.
Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for production-safe lubrication window is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R10 and the CASE-027 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-026.
